data.credibility: Management shows mixed reliability, frequently missing near-term EBITDA and organic growth targets while quietly dropping longer-term guidance topics in subsequent quarters rather than maintaining accountability.

lines.line: Promised 21% EBITDA for FY26; delivered 18.9%, missing the target.
Expected flattish to positive Q3 FY26 organic growth; delivered -1%.
Promised Q4 FY26 would have highest quarterly growth; delivered 12.0%.
Promised higher FY27 growth than FY26; current growth is 7.6% and dropped.
Guided FY27 EBITDA between 20.5% and 21.2%; tracking at 15.6% and dropped.
Expected 30% solutions and products growth in FY27; tracking at 7.6% and dropped.
Expected 60% solutions revenue share in 3 years; topic was subsequently dropped.
Expected medium-term EBITDA of 22% to 24%; currently at 15.6%, marked slipping.

bull: Revenue compounded at 26.0% annually and net profit at 34.1% over the past five years.
Operating cash flow reached 165% of reported profit over 5 years, showing strong cash conversion.
Working-capital days significantly tightened from -11 to -74 over five years, enhancing efficiency.
bear: FY26 EBITDA margin landed at 18.9%, missing the promised 21% guidance target.
FY27 performance is lagging, with EBITDA tracking at 15.6% and solutions growth at 7.6%.
Borrowings increased to ₹764 cr from ₹230 cr in FY21, raising debt levels.
